writ_date_note: 12June,37EdwardIII =1363; modern scholarly metadata labels c.1364. Do not silently claim1364enactment.
release: Good-behaviour surety also required; city's penalty does not extinguish victim's separate legal recovery.

curfew.signal: Bow bell between day and night
exception: known man of good repute OR his servant
curfew.logic: Reputation/service condition, cause and light together. Lantern alone insufficient.
curfew.violation: Newgate until fine and good surety; fine amount not supplied.

hosts: Warn guests to leave arms at lodging. Punishment clause depends on failure to warn leading to guest carrying; discretionary fine plus imprisonment, no fabricated sum.

court_case.recorded_outcome: Committed to prison then released same day on mainprise to keep peace.

visual_rule: Use local typography for rules and date labels; no photographed/painted fake documents. No gory injuries. Historical scenes are illustrative, never staged as recovered footage.
continuity: The opening is a flash-forward to the hypothetical night encounter. S004 returns to earlier daylight. S059–S064 offer a labelled alternative rather than silently claiming an actual arrest and escape. S076–S086 are a separate1365record; S088returns to the fictional1364challenge.
